description: This file defines the TimeDate class, which handles date and time operations, including formatting, parsing, timezone conversions, and date range calculations for the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for converting between user, database, and GMT timezones, as well as handling user preferences for date/time formats and timezones.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: A comprehensive class managing date/time formatting, parsing, and timezone conversions tailored for user preferences and system requirements within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton access method to obtain the global TimeDate instance.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the current user context for date/time operations.

methods.name: get_date_format
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's preferred date format.

methods.name: get_time_format
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's preferred time format.

methods.name: get_date_time_format
methods.description: Gets combined date and time format string based on user preferences.

methods.name: asDb
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object as a database-compatible datetime string.

methods.name: asUser
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into user preferred datetime string.

methods.name: fromDb
methods.description: Creates a SugarDateTime object from a database datetime string.

methods.name: fromUser
methods.description: Creates a SugarDateTime object from a user formatted datetime string.

methods.name: to_db
methods.description: Converts a user datetime string into a database datetime string in GMT.

methods.name: to_display_date
methods.description: Converts a DB date string to user display format, adjusting for timezone.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the current date/time, optionally cached.

methods.name: userTimezone
methods.description: Returns the name of the user's timezone.

methods.name: guessTimezone
methods.description: Guesses the timezone based on an offset or current system time.

methods.name: tzName
methods.description: Returns a localized display name for a timezone.

methods.name: parseDateRange
methods.description: Returns start and end date objects for common date range expressions like today, yesterday, last_month, etc.

methods.name: get_javascript_validation
methods.description: Provides Javascript validation variables setup for user date format validation (deprecated).

methods.name: AMPMMenu
methods.description: Renders an HTML SELECT element for AM/PM based on user time format preferences (deprecated).

methods.name: get_user_date_format
methods.description: Returns the user's date format in JS compatible string (e.g., 'yyyy/mm/dd').

methods.name: get_user_time_format
methods.description: Returns an example of the user's time format string (e.g., '23:00'), marked as deprecated.
